UFA: union of all overlapped annotated unknown objects by accepted non-TP boxes; object-level
BG_FP: accepted box with no known or unknown GT overlap at IoU>=.50; detection-level
aspect_cue: log(pixel box width / pixel box height), not normalized width/height ratio
boundary_min_cue: min nonnegative pixel gap / min(image width,image height)
near_edge_count_cue: number of sides with gap<=0.015*max(image width,image height)
